visualCharacteristics.notes: Full-bleed image with percentage-positioned + markers that open title/text popups, heading and Hotspots switch overlaid bottom-left; on small screens the popup and prev/next hotspot controls sit below the image.

contentPattern.structure: row 1: image | heading (h2); then one row per hotspot: position ('top: 85%, left: 58%' or '85%, 58%' = top, left) | title + paragraph

suitableFor: annotated images with clickable points of interest
notSuitableFor: content without meaningful positions on a single image
